title: Mean of a uniform random sign
statement: For every function $g:\{−1,1\}\to\mathbb R$, its uniform mean over the two signs is $\mathbb E_b[g(b)]=(g(1)+g(-1))/2$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is a real-valued function on the two signs
